title: VSift JSONL terminal event v1
description: The last line of every --events jsonl stream; exactly one per stream. Its sequence is the number of events before it (0 when it is the only line, as for every failure). Validate result with operation-response.schema.json and result.data with the command's data schema; a transcript.get stream ends with transcript-get-stream-data.schema.json data, and a search stream with search-stream-data.schema.json data, after its evidence events (evidence-event.schema.json).
